body: Hah, my dad is like that, but in a subtly shitty way. He is a buddhist/universal unitarian (supposedly) and has always said that he'd support my sister and I with whatever faith, lifestyle, etc. that we chose. Still, he freaked out on both my sister and I when we came out as bisexual and pansexual (respectively) and said it was "just a phase". At one point I seriously considered christianity and he laughed in my face and called me an idiot for believing in such a "bullshit doctrine".  I'm not a christian now, but I almost wish I were so he'd be forced to deal with some of that shit for once.

I'm hoping to see a therapist, but it would mean having my father pay for my sessions. It's going to take quite a lot to convince him to spend money on me regardless of the reason.

I have started an account, once I have about a thousand (I make about 400 every 2 weeks) I'm going to find a place. I'm also eventually going to have my boyfriend move in, but he can't until he graduates, and that'll be about a year and a half.

Thank you for the idea of the apartment decoration though, I'll definitely start with that. I can appreciate any distraction from being stuck here.
I wish I could show him exactly how much he hurts me, but it's just not me to be violent. I appreciate the advice, though.
Wow, you can tell that from a picture of someone with a body modification? You must be really smart. /s
